title: Unifying multimodal understanding and generation
reading: The slide presents the idea of unifying multimodal understanding and generation within a single model, describing a unified autoregressive model that can produce both text tokens and visual tokens. It cites MetaMorph (Tong et al., 2024), which achieves this through instruction tuning.

concepts.name: Unified autoregressive multimodal model
concepts.why_it_matters: A single next-token predictor handling text and image tokens removes the need for separate understanding and generation systems.

concepts.name: Visual tokens
concepts.why_it_matters: Discretized image representations let images be modeled in the same sequence as text.

concepts.name: MetaMorph / instruction tuning
concepts.why_it_matters: Cited example showing multimodal generation can emerge from instruction tuning.

verbatim_spans: A unified autoregressive model capable of generating both text and visual tokens
MetaMorph: Multimodal Understanding and Generation via Instruction Tuning
